verdict.rationale: Context.dev offers agent-like data gathering, including live-web research and schema-driven extraction, so this axis applies. However, no evidence shows a selectable reasoning-effort setting (low/medium/high). The extract endpoint's 'grounding, coverage, and freshness' controls and the timeout deadlines are related but different controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can set how much reasoning effort an autonomous agent spends on a data-gathering task (low, medium, high)
